gap: No result ChatGPT got states today's price for each wireless number-pad board at its maker's store against the retailer price: three of the boards it named are over $60 at the maker (Womier X98 $84.99, Redragon K689 PRO $64.99, AULA F99 main listing $63.99) and only fit the budget at Amazon, while the Keychron J5 is $44.99 at Keychron, not the $59.99 ChatGPT's closing line gave.
standout_why: Compared against the two cited pages and the top result. techgearden.com prices only one wireless number-pad board under $60 (Redragon K689 PRO, $44.64) and puts the AULA F99 at $63.99; it has no Keychron J5, Womier X98, Attack Shark X98, Rosewill S96 or Gamakay TK101. kazsushibistro.com has no number-pad board under $60 at all (AULA F99 'under $70'). keebkit.com names the RK100 and Redragon K580 as 'under $60' with no exact price and no connection info. None sets maker-store price beside retailer price. The finding is new and useful but does not on its own decide the pick, because I could not read the Gamakay TK101's specs (store returned HTTP 429 on every attempt).
decides: Confirms the Keychron J5 as the pick on the question's terms: $44.99 at Keychron on 2026-11-21, a full-size 100% layout, 2.4 GHz + Bluetooth 5.2 + wired, hot-swap, QMK, 3,750 mAh. It also corrects ChatGPT, which priced the J5 at $44.99 and $59.99 in the same answer. None of the keyboards we already link fits: all seven are 75% boards with no number pad, and the nearest, the Gamakay NS75, is $63.99. The only partner board that fits is the Gamakay TK101 (98%, 101 keys, $47.99, no record yet), so the page needs a new record for it or is a skip. The TK101 is $3.00 more than the J5 and the same $47.99 at Amazon as at Gamakay, so there is no price advantage to claim through our link. The segment it wins is unsettled until its battery, hot-swap and mount are read from Gamakay's page. Line drawn at $60 paid on 2026-11-21: left out for being just over are the AULA F99 main listing ($63.99), Redragon K689 PRO at Redragon's store ($64.99) and our Gamakay NS75 ($63.99, no number pad anyway).
